description: This file defines the EventHubDataAdapter class, which implements the IEventHubDataAdapter interface. It provides methods for converting between EventHub messages and internal cache representations, generating stream positions and offsets, and encoding message payloads into segments. The class is part of the Orleans streaming infrastructure for Event Hubs integration.

classes.name: EventHubDataAdapter
classes.description: Implements data adaptation for Event Hub messages within Orleans streaming, including message conversion, stream position management, and payload encoding.

methods.name: GetBatchContainer
methods.description: Converts a cached message into a batch container for delivery.

methods.name: GetStreamSequenceToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stream sequence token from a cached message.

methods.name: ToQueueMessage
methods.description: Converts stream data into an EventData message for enqueueing.

methods.name: FromQueueMessage
methods.description: Creates a cached message from an EventData message received from the queue.

methods.name: GetStreamPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the stream position based on partition and EventData message.

methods.name: GetOffset
methods.description: Extracts the offset string from a cached message segment.

methods.name: GetPartitionKey
methods.description: Returns the partition key for a given stream ID.

methods.name: GetStreamIdentity
methods.description: Determines the stream identity from an EventData message.

methods.name: EncodeMessageIntoSegment
methods.description: Encodes an EventData message into a byte segment for storage or transmission.
